# Model: `cities`

- **data_source:** `bench`
- **sql_table:** `cities`
- **row_count:** 10

## Columns (4)

| name | type | primary_key | sql | allowed_aggregations | sampled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| city | TEXT | yes | city | all | Oslo, Bergen, Lisbon, Naples, Porto, Prague, Rome, Trondheim, Vienna |
| region_id | DOUBLE | yes | region_id | all | 1 .. 4 |
| population | DOUBLE | — | population | all | 3000 .. 2800000 |
| size_class | TEXT | — | size_class | all | large, medium, small |

## Measures (0)

_(none)_

## Joins (2)

| target_model | join_pairs | cardinality |
| --- | --- | --- |
| regions | region_id = id | many_to_one |
| customers | city = city; region_id = region_id | one_to_many |

## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  cities.city AS "cities.city",
  cities.size_class AS "cities.size_class",
  COUNT(*) AS "cities._count",
  CAST(AVG(cities.region_id) AS DOUBLE) AS "cities.region_id_avg",
  CAST(AVG(cities.population) AS DOUBLE) AS "cities.population_avg"
FROM cities AS cities
GROUP BY
  cities.city,
  cities.size_class
ORDER BY
  "cities.city" ASC,
  "cities.size_class" ASC
LIMIT 5
```

## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  customers.name AS "customers.name",
  customers.city AS "customers.city",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers._count",
  CAST(AVG(customers.region_id) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.region_id_avg",
  COUNT(DISTINCT customers.tier) AS "customers.tier_count_distinct",
  CAST(AVG(customers.credit) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_avg",
  CAST(AVG(customers.discount) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.discount_avg",
  COUNT(customers.tags) AS "customers.tags_count"
FROM customers AS customers
GROUP BY
  customers.name,
  customers.city
ORDER BY
  "customers.name" ASC,
  "customers.city" ASC
LIMIT 3
```
